newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: KTL EARNS 11 MILLION LITAS IN FIRST QUARTER.
newsitem.headline: KTL EARNS 11 MILLION LITAS IN FIRST QUARTER.

text.p: The Klaipeda Transport Fleet (KTL) said it earned 11 million litas in the first quarter of 1997, twice as much as in the same period last year, newspaper Verslo Zinios reported on Monday.
KTL Vice-President Andrius Tenkutis said it was impossible to forecast what its profit would be because much depended on the seasons, Verslo Zinios said.
"In the winter, prices for transport are higher," Tenkutis was quoted as saying in Verslo Zinios.
However, in 1997, the company plans to earn no less than it did last year, when its before tax profit was 27 million litas, the newspaper reported.
The state owns 80 percent of KTL's share capital
